required_fixes.title: The human-gate trigger in v56 cannot fire; product is starved behind a dead exit
required_fixes.defect: v56 routes the ONE owner question through requirement 13(b) on an accepted frontier outcome B. Requirement 13(b) supersedes the DO-NOT-SERVE order only via 'an accepted bounded negative converting the map-versus-ranked-list choice into ONE explicit owner product decision'. The RUN charter's own outcome (B) text says the accepted DO-NOT-SERVE order STANDS, and the team's accepted state records charter_outcome=B with owner_decision_required=false. Outcome (C) is the bounded-negative branch. So 'outcome B fires the owner question under 13(b)' asserts a supersession 13(b) does not describe, and the Master Prompt's Human product gate (canonical implementation step 7) has no defined firing condition.

required_fixes.required_fix: State the trigger once as a disjunction over requirement 13's actual conditions: (i) an accepted outcome-A verdict that explicitly replaces DO-NOT-SERVE under 13(a); (ii) an accepted BOUNDED NEGATIVE under 13(b), which per the charter requires BOTH absolute bars unmet AND no in-budget fix; (iii) a recorded director determination that the product question can no longer be advanced from evidence, which the Master Prompt reserves as the owner's decision. Delete or correct the assertion that outcome B fires 13(b); B leaves DO-NOT-SERVE in force and opens no human gate. Re-point the product lane's ordered delta at the corrected trigger so the lane is not building a card for an event that cannot occur.

required_fixes.title: The determination that decides F1 rests on a label reading the frozen rubric forbids
required_fixes.defect: The rebuilt packet issues n_scored=5. The frozen rubric RULES_LABEL.json verdict_rule states INSUFFICIENT_POPULATION applies when 'n_scored < required_min_population_primary' (7) and 'This is a NON-RESULT: it must not be read as LABEL_SOUND nor as a pass of any product fix'. The team instead used the instrument reading (label_gate.py:135 emits LABEL_SOUND when n_supported == n_scored) to conclude 'The label bar is met as written on the rebuilt bytes (LABEL_SOUND; 5/5 issued supported). The charter therefore does not convert the map-versus-ranked-list choice into an owner decision.' A NON-RESULT is thereby used, through a favourable instrument reading, to withhold the bounded negative that would have opened the owner gate.

required_fixes.title: Requirement 28 pre-declares the gate value of a future independent audit
required_fixes.defect: New factory-wide requirement 28 states 'If a THIRD cycle ships a claim-bearing reproduction/sha-pin defect of this class, the independent audit MUST return gate=BLOCKED (not REVISE)'. state/frontier_portfolio.json v28 policy repeats 'must gate BLOCKED (not REVISE)'. This writes a future independent audit's verdict into control-plane state that every agent, including independent_auditor, is required to read, and whose card forbids collaborating with the producer to obtain a verdict; factory_director card forbids overriding audits. A gate chosen in advance is not evidence and destroys the escalation's value.
